## 📋 Pull Request Description
<!-- Give a brief summary of what this PR does and why it was created -->

### 🎯 Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🔨 Refactor (code restructuring without changing external behavior)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️ Configuration / Build / CI update
- [ ] 🚨 Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to change)

### 📁 Affected Module(s)
- [ ] `frontend/` (React Native / Expo App)
- [ ] `backend/` (API Server / Services)
- [ ] `database/` (Schemas / Migrations / Local DB)
- [ ] `connectivity/` (BLE / Mesh / SMS / Offline Protocols)
- [ ] Root / Project Config / Documentation

### 🔗 Related Issue / Task
<!-- e.g. Closes #12, Fixes #34 -->

### 🧪 How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Manual test on Android Emulator / Physical Device
- [ ] Manual test on iOS Simulator / Physical Device
- [ ] TypeScript check passed (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] API endpoints verified with Postman / curl
- [ ] Unit / Integration tests passed

### 📸 Screenshots / Demos (If applicable)
<!-- Please attach screenshots, GIFs, or short video links for UI changes -->

### ✅ Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the repository style and naming guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] No sensitive data, API keys, credentials, or `.env` files are committed
- [ ] Branch is rebased/merged with the latest `develop` branch
- [ ] At least 1 team member has reviewed and approved this PR
